_about: Feature 17 (22 Oct): no ticket without the reporter's name, and on a call with no number of its own, a number. Ten incoming calls in בר כוכבא 23, the one building opened for tests. Claude plays each caller as a real person and the agent from the candidate prompt and tools. Scored by scripts/check_name_flow.py against each card's expect.

defaults._how: What a tool returns when the scenario has no fixture for it. <ticket> is the scenario's `ticket`; <spoken> is its middle serial as Hebrew digit words, one word per digit (255-1541-26 -> אחת חמש ארבע אחת).

open_request._rule: Apply these in order. (1) The building, exactly as before: Bar Kochba (בר כוכבא, any spelling) with another number: number_not_on_street; Bar Kochba with no number: need_number; any other street: street_unknown. (2) ONLY if open_request's parameters in the context include reporter_name: no reporter_name and no name_declined true: need_name. (3) Only then, ONLY if the card's call_has_number is false: no reporter_phone and no phone_declined true: need_phone. (4) No building at all: need_building. Otherwise opened. A second call with the same building and type inside 30 minutes returns the first reference with duplicate: true.

notify_team._rule: reason is echoed back as sent.

get_balance._rule: Building בר כוכבא 23 with apartment 1, 2 or 3: that flat's record (the scenario's fixture). Any other flat: found 0 with the note.

not_found.note: No single apartment matched, so no balance was read: this is NOT a zero balance. Say you could not find it, and ask for or check the street, number and apartment with them.

get_service_info.note: No topic matched. Say you do not have that detail and offer the office; do not guess.

scenarios.title: A stairwell light is out; he never offers his name

caller.persona: אבי, 45, in a hurry, polite, short answers. Speaks about himself in the masculine.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 5. The light on the third-floor landing has been out for two days; it is dark on the stairs in the evening.
caller.tendencies: Starts with the problem, not a greeting. Answers only what he is asked. Does not volunteer his name or flat.

scenarios.title: She says her name, building and flat in the first breath

caller.persona: דנה לוי, 38, organised and direct. Speaks about herself in the feminine.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 4. Water is dripping from the ceiling of the ground-floor lobby near the mailboxes since this morning.
caller.tendencies: Opens with: her name, building and flat, then the leak, all in one sentence. Gets a little impatient if asked for something she already said.

scenarios.title: Will not give a name: why does it matter, just fix it

caller.persona: A man in his 60s, suspicious of giving details on the phone, gruff but not rude.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 7. The lift has been stuck on the second floor since the afternoon; nobody is inside.
caller.tendencies: When asked his name, says it does not matter. If asked again, refuses again and says just open it. Gives the building and flat when asked.

scenarios.title: A strong smell of gas in the stairwell, frightened

caller.persona: רונית, 52, frightened and talking fast. Speaks about herself in the feminine.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 2. A strong smell of gas on the stairwell between the first and second floors, started ten minutes ago.
caller.wants: Help now; asks what she should do.
caller.tendencies: Starts with the smell, before any greeting. Asks whether to open windows. Gives her name and building when asked, quickly.

scenarios.title: Wants to arrange paying the building fee in instalments

caller.persona: יוסי, 41, friendly, a bit embarrassed about being behind.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 1. Knows he owes a few months of the building fee.
caller.wants: To pay it off in instalments.
caller.tendencies: Says he wants to pay but in parts. Does not ask how much he owes. Gives details when asked.

scenarios.title: Her kitchen sink is blocked: her own fixture

caller.persona: מירב, 33, chatty. Speaks about herself in the feminine.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 3. Her kitchen sink drains very slowly since yesterday; nothing else in the building is affected.
caller.wants: Someone to come and fix the sink.
caller.tendencies: Explains the sink in detail. Accepts kindly when told it is hers to handle.

scenarios.title: A building Homies does not manage

caller.knows: Lives at הרצל 5, Ramat Gan. The entrance door of his building does not close.
caller.tendencies: Says his address when asked, the same way twice if asked again.

scenarios.title: Homies staff calling from the office extension for a tenant: the call has no number

caller.persona: שירן from the Homies office, calling on behalf of an elderly tenant. Speaks about herself in the feminine.
caller.knows: The tenant is משה ברק, בר כוכבא 23, apartment 6. The building's front gate does not lock since this morning. The tenant's number is 052-4418823.
caller.wants: A ticket for the gate, with the tenant's details.
caller.tendencies: Says she is calling from the office for a tenant. Gives the tenant's name and number when asked.

scenarios.title: Asks what is happening with yesterday's ticket

caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 8. Reported a broken intercom yesterday; does not remember the ticket number.
caller.tendencies: Gives the building and flat when asked. Thanks and ends the call.

scenarios.title: Two problems in one call: the lift is noisy, and the mailbox door is broken

caller.persona: נעמה, 29, cheerful. Speaks about herself in the feminine.
caller.knows: Lives at בר כוכבא 23, apartment 9. The lift makes a loud grinding noise between floors. The little door of the building's mailbox for flat 9 is broken off.
caller.tendencies: Reports the lift first. After the first ticket, adds: and one more thing, the mailbox.
